regions.name: Lower observed region
regions.evidence: r01-r08 RGB and measured LIO establish the lower current pose-height region, south hall and west fore-room. Later postVIO tracks the two-flight ascent and landing. The lower hall +y long axis has remote measured returns but no actual traversal as of r24. This is a measured height display, not a global floor boundary or support model.

regions.name: Upper observed region
regions.evidence: r16-r19 RGB confirm the two-flight transition, upper landing, open door and white-tile corridor; r20-r24 RGB confirm upper hall, sofas, plants and reception desk. By r24 actual postVIO follows the southern hall side and the western side of the reception desk to the northern blue-wall sofa. Mapped low returns vary spatially; 3.1-4.7m is a broad display band, not one physical plane. The eastern wing, desk far side and lateral openings remain untraversed or incompletely seen. Remote high-z returns beyond y40 are retained and shown separately, not assigned as another floor.
